sources.title: Introducing LFM2.5: The Next Generation of On-Device AI
sources.snippet: Vision-Language Model LFM2.5-VL-1.6B is our refreshed vision-language model, built on an updated LFM2.5-base backbone and tuned for stronger real-world performance. This release delivers clear gains in multi-image comprehension, and it also improves multilingual vision understanding, handling prompts in Arabic, Chinese, French, German, Japanese, Korean, and Spanish with greater accuracy.
